rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: docs/api/proxy.md retry section does not say that an interrupted wait after a 502 or 503 answers through the error flow with an HttpException of that status instead of relaying the backend response: ## 재시도 ... - 마지막 재시도 뒤에도 `502`나 `503`이면 그 백엔드 응답을 그대로 넘깁니다. - 요청 스레드가 인터럽트되면 재시도를 멈추고 인터럽트 상태를 유지합니다. (runtime part passed: client got 502 without the backend's X-From-Backend header, onError got a plain HttpException, not a ProxyException; en/proxy.md Retries has the same gap)
rows.note: Retry sections (ko/en) say a remaining 502/503 is relayed unchanged and an interrupt only stops retries; the code answers an interrupted wait after a closed 502/503 with a plain HttpException through onError (the onError example comments list only 400/405/501/413 for that branch).

rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: the slot was held 2599 ms after the client reset (read timeout 4 s); en bullet: - The slot is taken after every check and `req.bodyStream(...)` pass, right before the backend connect, and returned when the request ends (the response body fully relayed or the client gone). (reproduced twice: 2707 ms, 2599 ms)
rows.note: Over real TinyHttpd sockets, a client that resets while the backend is silent mid-body keeps the maxConcurrent(1) slot until the read timeout; proxy.md/en ¶Concurrency say the slot returns when the client is gone, and Thread model covers only the wait before the response starts.
